name: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
summary: AURA enables low-latency, causal video generation for streaming applications by utilizing a rolling KV cache and a two-stage distillation pipeline to significantly reduce the required diffusion steps.
